findings.source: Raskolnikov: Он умолял, плакал, беспомощно просил не убивать его.
findings.currentTarget: Raskolnikov: Aliomba, akalia, akawasihi bila msaada wasimuue.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Raskolnikov: Aliomba, akalia, akamsihi bila msaada asimuue.
findings.objectiveReason: The victim pleads with one armed man: preceding ordered units explicitly establish that man and his singular commands. Current akawasihi/wasimuue switches the assailant to multiple people.

findings.source: Theorist: Например, вот вам ещё один документ.
findings.currentTarget: Theorist: Kwa mfano, hii ni nyaraka nyingine.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Theorist: Kwa mfano, huu ni waraka mwingine.
findings.objectiveReason: Russian presents one further document. Current hii ni nyaraka nyingine uses singular demonstrative with plural nyaraka; waraka with huu/mwingine preserves one document and agrees.
